rows.title: Digit-count parse
rows.defect: the family text is read from the unit group
rows.test: apply to 15 investment banking intern roles

rows.title: Spelled counts
rows.defect: fifteen resolves to 14
rows.test: fifteen resolves to 15

rows.title: Unclaimed asks stay unclaimed
rows.defect: a non-matching ask fabricates a batch
rows.test: count-less asks return null

rows.title: New run state
rows.defect: a new run starts already approved
rows.test: a new run starts in the new state

rows.title: Duplicates counted
rows.defect: duplicates are removed but never counted
rows.test: a cross-board duplicate counts as removed

rows.title: Closed screens out
rows.defect: closed postings stay eligible
rows.test: a closed posting is JOB_CLOSED

rows.title: Knockouts screen out
rows.defect: knockout results are discarded
rows.test: an unmet license knockout is KNOCKOUT_UNMET

rows.title: Current employer screens out
rows.defect: the current-employer block never fires
rows.test: the user's own employer is CURRENT_EMPLOYER

rows.title: Count deferral
rows.defect: every eligible posting is selected regardless of count
rows.test: eligible beyond the count are COUNT_DEFERRED

rows.title: The approval card
rows.defect: the batch card is never built
rows.test: doorstep applications get a batch_approval card

rows.title: ApprovalRef binding
rows.defect: the approvalRef is not bound to the card set hash
rows.test: the ref includes the card set hash

rows.title: Changed set refused
rows.defect: the card set hash is never re-checked at approval
rows.test: a tampered payload refuses approval

rows.title: The yes is required
rows.defect: an approval without the user's yes still mints
rows.test: approvedByUser false mints nothing

rows.title: Execution needs approval
rows.defect: execution runs without an approval
rows.test: an unapproved run submits nothing

rows.title: Submissions land
rows.defect: a completed submit is recorded as still at the doorstep
rows.test: an approved clean batch submits 3 with confirmations

rows.title: Uncovered question named
rows.defect: the uncovered-question stop is renamed
rows.test: an uncovered required field stops as UNCOVERED_QUESTION

rows.title: Captcha is a handoff
rows.defect: the captcha stop is recorded as solved
rows.test: a captcha at open stops as CAPTCHA_HANDOFF

rows.title: Cap deferral at click
rows.defect: click-time cap deferrals are recorded under another code
rows.test: cap overflow defers as CAP_REACHED with a resume day

rows.title: Drive errors named
rows.defect: drive errors are recorded as EXECUTION_OK
rows.test: a throwing drive stops as EXECUTION_ERROR

rows.title: Restore round-trips
rows.defect: restore always returns null
rows.test: a serialized run restores and approves

rows.title: Report names submissions
rows.defect: the spoken summary omits the submissions line
rows.test: the spoken summary names the submitted count
